def event_perception_policy(sc_cnt, ev_cnt, stale, misses, has_pos, dist, vel, center, target_x, visible, search_req, moving, on_path, has_mem):
    accept_init = 1.0 if (sc_cnt >= 3.0 and ev_cnt >= 2.0) else 0.0
    accept_track = 1.0 if (sc_cnt >= 3.0 and ev_cnt >= 0.0) else 0.0
    coast = 1.0 if (0.0 > 0.5) else 0.0
    reset = 1.0 if (stale >= 2.0 or misses >= 2.0) else 0.0
    aim = clip(target_x + 0.5 * vel, 1.0, 14.0)
    d = abs(center - aim)
    gv = 0.5 if search_req > 0.5 else max(0.01, 1.0 - d / 15.0)
    raw_info = min(1.0, 0.45 + 0.55 * visible + 0.15 * has_mem) - 0.0 * pos(d - 2.5)
    info = (1.0 if moving > 0.5 else 0.05) if search_req > 0.5 else max(0.05, raw_info)
    eff = 1.2 if moving > 0.5 else 1.0
    util = gv * info / eff + 0.08 * on_path
    return (accept_init, accept_track, coast, reset, util)
